'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Yesterday, while I was mounting a red dot on an M4, I noticed someone on one of my monitors who looked like he was praying. He had covered the walls with strange symbols, drawn a circle on the floor, and started placing weapons inside it. Oddly enough... it made sense to me. That's how religion works, isn't it? You offer your gods the things that matter most to you. Seems those cultists think the same way. You've probably run into them already. Anyway, back to business. I've got enough electrical capacity for now. Go find me some more graphics cards and cooling fans.}}

==Objectives==
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: 1 [[Graphics card]]
* Hand over the [[Graphics card|item]]
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: 8 [[CPU fan]]
* Hand over the [[CPU fan|items]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Tech manual]]
* Unlocks barter of [[Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle]] (variant T-SAW) at [[Mechanic]] LL3
{{quote|Ah, you've returned. I'll try to assemble them till nightfall, thanks. I know, it's really hard to find such electronics during these hard times, but I never doubted you.}}
